name: Vital Wound
additional_info: Uppercutting your opponent applies the Vital Wound status effect for 20 seconds, which only affects their passive posture recovery. The reduction starts at 100% and scales down as the remaining duration runs out. This has no cooldown, but it cannot be refreshed or reapplied while it's active.
desc: Uppercutting your opponent punctures their lungs, slowing their rate of posture recovery for 20 seconds. This starts at 100% with it scaling down based on the duration of the effect left.
